title: Dokrahm
extract:
The Dokrahm is a  Slash-focused Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Dokrahm blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike primarily deals  Slash damage.

15%  Impact
35%  Puncture
50%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Scythe
Heavy Blade
